organization.name: Apex Financial Technologies S.A.
organization.audit_scope: Enterprise Hybrid AWS Cloud & Corporate Infrastructure

subcategories.title: Organizational Mission & Regulatory Stakeholders
subcategories.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management.
subcategories.evidence: Business strategy defines growth targets, but cybersecurity risk appetite is not formalized in board charter.
subcategories.gap: Lack of quantified risk appetite metrics (e.g. Value-at-Risk) reviewed by Board of Directors.
subcategories.remediation: Establish a Board-level Cybersecurity Committee with quarterly review of quantified risk tolerance.

subcategories.title: Third-Party Supplier Due Diligence
subcategories.description: Suppliers and third-party partners are assessed prior to entering into contracts.
subcategories.evidence: Procurement conducts ad-hoc security questionnaires. No continuous monitoring of SaaS vendor posture.
subcategories.gap: High risk of third-party breach via critical cloud providers without SOC 2 Type II validation.
subcategories.remediation: Implement an automated Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) platform and mandate SOC 2 / ISO 27001 for Tier 1 vendors.

subcategories.title: Hardware & Virtual Infrastructure Inventory
subcategories.description: Inventories of physical and virtual hardware systems are maintained.
subcategories.evidence: AWS resources tracked via Terraform, but on-prem endpoints and branch office devices rely on manual spreadsheets.
subcategories.gap: Shadow IT and unmanaged laptops connecting via remote VPN without continuous endpoint discovery.
subcategories.remediation: Deploy automated Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM) agent syncing all assets into CMDB.

subcategories.title: Vulnerability Identification & Threat Modeling
subcategories.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded.
subcategories.evidence: Quarterly external penetration testing performed; internal vulnerability scanning is irregular.
subcategories.gap: Zero automated container image scanning in CI/CD pipeline leading to vulnerable third-party packages in production.
subcategories.remediation: Integrate automated DevSecOps container security scanner (Trivy/Snyk) into GitLab CI pipeline with build-blocking policy.

subcategories.title: Credential & Identity Lifecycle Management
subcategories.description: Identities and credentials for authorized users and services are managed.
subcategories.evidence: Google Workspace / Okta in place, but legacy administrator accounts exist in AWS without MFA enforcement.
subcategories.gap: CRITICAL: Multiple privileged IAM users have non-expiring access keys and SMS MFA vulnerable to SIM-swapping.
subcategories.remediation: Enforce FIDO2 / WebAuthn hardware security keys for all privileged access; automate IAM key rotation every 90 days.

subcategories.title: Data-at-Rest & In-Transit Protection
subcategories.description: Sensitive data is protected at rest and in transit.
subcategories.evidence: TLS 1.3 enforced on public APIs; RDS database encrypted with AWS KMS.
subcategories.gap: Lack of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls on employee workstations and customer support ticketing exports.
subcategories.remediation: Deploy endpoint DLP to block unencrypted cardholder data exports; implement automated PII tokenization.

subcategories.title: Network & Cloud Telemetry Monitoring
subcategories.description: Networks and computing environments are monitored to detect potential security events.
subcategories.evidence: AWS CloudWatch and GuardDuty enabled. Centralized SIEM lacks endpoint detection telemetry.
subcategories.gap: No EDR deployed on 40% of macOS/Linux engineer workstations; blind spots in lateral movement detection.
subcategories.remediation: Deploy enterprise EDR (CrowdStrike/Wazuh) across 100% of workstations and integrate into 24/7 MDR SOC.

subcategories.title: Incident Response Plan & Execution
subcategories.description: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
subcategories.evidence: A generic Incident Response PDF exists from 2023. No tabletop exercises conducted; no SLA defined for regulatory disclosure.
subcategories.gap: High risk of non-compliance with EU DORA strict 4-hour major incident notification requirements.
subcategories.remediation: Revise IRP with DORA-compliant escalation matrix; conduct bi-annual executive ransomware tabletop simulation.

subcategories.title: Restoration of Core Banking Services
subcategories.description: Recovery activities are performed to restore operations and services.
subcategories.evidence: Daily automated AWS snapshots taken and replicated to secondary EU region.
subcategories.gap: Backups have not undergone a clean bare-metal restoration drill in the past 12 months; RTO/RPO untested.
subcategories.remediation: Implement immutable AWS S3 Object Lock for air-gapped ransomware backups and conduct full disaster recovery failover drill.
